scheme_name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Assistance to SHG for Job Work
other_conditions: The SHG must have at least 25 female members
The SHG should be engaged in job work for industrial units
The industrial unit must pay ₹5,000 per month per female worker in addition to the job work charges
SHGs independently engaged in manufacturing (not job work) are not eligible
benefits_summary: Provides ₹5,000 per month per member for 3 months as training assistance and payroll assistance of 25% of job‑work value up to ₹5,000 per month per member for 5 years.
